resolution.$comment: How a project's effective configuration is built from the global defaults and its entry. Same name in the entry: override. New name: project. Untouched default: global. inherit false drops every default; disabled… drops single ones. A project whose merged configuration breaks a rule (a kind with nothing to write) is not visible.

globalInstructions.$comment: A job kind names instructions (project-relative; wins when the project has the file), globalInstructions (an absolute path, or a file under <app_data_dir>/<dirName>/), or both. The IDE reads a global file itself and puts its text into the prompt; documents.* never serves it and no client error names its path. A name under dirName must resolve inside it (no symlink escape); the file is regular, UTF-8 and at most maxBytes. A proposal may only use the dirName form.

proposals.$comment: link_policy_propose (control socket, supervisor callers only) stores a pending proposal and raises an inbox ask with Apply and Discard. Only the IDE's Tauri command decides; no socket method does, and external callers (the link socket included) get outside_supervisor_scope for both link_policy methods. Apply writes only onto the policy the proposal was made against (else outdated). Every outcome is one line in the audit log.

supervisorKeys.$comment: A supervisor key is an address a client picks for a supervisor; it is not a permission. Unique among live supervisors (a finished one frees its key). spawn: what supervisors.spawn does with key and if against the live supervisors; a key that resolves to nobody on agents.read/send/kill or jobs.create is unknown_supervisor. Keys shaped like an agent id (reservedPattern) are refused, so a supervisors entry in events.subscribe never names two supervisors at once.

subtree.$comment: events.subscribe { supervisors } and supervisors.list over one agent list. A supervisors entry is a key or an agent id; it covers the supervisor, every descendant through the spawnedByAgentId chain (recomputed every poll, so a child started later joins), the agents of jobs it requested and those jobs. An unknown entry covers nothing and is no error. agentIds and supervisors together are their union. Without supervisors, job events are not filtered (as before); with them, only the covered jobs. rootSupervisorIds is LinkAgent.rootSupervisorId: the topmost supervisor of the chain, null where the chain reaches no listed supervisor. finished is what run results still keep after a supervisor ended. roles (feature roleFilter) narrows what the other filters cover to agents whose own role is listed; alone it covers every listed agent of that role, so a supervisor started later is covered from the next poll. It does not pull in a supervisor's children and it does not filter job events (only supervisors does).
